execute_muf.py.content_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

exe, db, source = [str(Path(path).resolve()) for path in sys.argv[1:]]
work = Path.cwd()
subprocess.run(["ip", "link", "set", "lo", "up"], check=True)
password = "Corpus-" + secrets.token_hex(12)
result = subprocess.run(
    [exe, "-dbin", db, "-dbout", "login.db", "-godpasswd", password],
    capture_output=True, timeout=15
)
if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))
with socket.socket() as binding:
    binding.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    port = binding.getsockname()[1]
with open("server.log", "w") as log:
    server = subprocess.Popen([exe, "-nodetach", "-bindv4", "127.0.0.1", "-dbin", "login.db", "-dbout", "result.db", str(port)], stdout=log, stderr=log)
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            try:
                conn = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), 0.25)
                break
            except OSError:
                if server.poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError(Path("server.log").read_text())
                time.sleep(0.05)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("No local Fuzzball socket")
        with conn:
            conn.settimeout(0.25)
            def send(body=b""):
                if body:
                    conn.sendall(body)
                data = bytearray()
                until = time.monotonic() + 1.3
                while time.monotonic() < until:
                    try:
                        block = conn.recv(16384)
                    except socket.timeout:
                        if data:
                            break
                        continue
                    if not block:
                        break
                    data.extend(block)
                text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").replace(password, "<ephemeral>")
                print(text, end="", flush=True)
                return text

            send()
            player = re.search(r"(?m)^#1\r?\n([^\r\n]+)", Path(db).read_text()).group(1)
            reply = send(("connect " + player + " " + password + "\n").encode())
            if re.search(r"(bad password|Either that player does not exist)", reply, re.IGNORECASE):
                raise RuntimeError("Could not start the disposable wizard test session")
            send(b"@program CorpusGreeting\n")
            send(b"i\n" + Path(source).read_bytes() + b".\n")
            compiled = send(b"c\n")
            if re.search(r"error", compiled, re.IGNORECASE):
                raise RuntimeError("MUF compile error")
            send(b"q\n")
            send(b"@action corpus-check=me\n")
            send(b"@link corpus-check=CorpusGreeting\n")
            send(b"look\n")
            output = send(b"corpus-check\n")
            if not any(line.strip() == "Hello, World!" for line in output.splitlines()):
                raise RuntimeError("The native MUF action did not notify the session")
            print("MUF notification readback: Hello, World!")
    finally:
        if server.poll() is None:
            server.terminate()
            try:
                server.wait(3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                server.kill()
                server.wait()

toolchain: Fuzzball 7.2.1 native MUF compiler and interpreter
reproduction_command: python3 execute_muf.py <fbmuck> <minimal.db> hello.muf in an isolated network namespace
semantic_scope: Fuzzball loaded the original MUF source through its editor, compiled it, dispatched it as an action and delivered the exact native notification to the test player.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
